lines.text: The root is Scrib! Describe, prescribe, subscribe.
Did you know? Scrib is Latin for write.
Quick quiz! Which means under plus write?

words.ex: Can you describe the man you saw?

words.mean: write before, as a doctor does
words.ex: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my throat infection last week.
Our department subscribes to several business magazines and newspapers.
